overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 1 of 2 positive segments is detected with no false alarms (hit rate 0.5000; F1 0.6667). At all identified confidence levels, both positive segments are detected with no false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No strict instance-level true positives: both identified findings are correctly localized with full mechanisms but use near-neighbor labels, and the candidate is unsupported on a neutral segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring credits 1 of 2 hidden instances at high_and_moderate and both at all identified confidence levels; candidate inclusion adds one false positive without adding a true positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The rollout candidate is a useful abstention because it is explicitly cautious and evidence-valid, but treating it as a detection at the fourth threshold produces a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Both identified bias labels are near neighbors rather than the benchmark target labels, producing zero strict instance-level true positives.
The shortlist finding is low confidence, so it is missed at the high-only and high-and-moderate thresholds.
The planning-fallacy candidate is attached to a hidden-negative rollout segment and becomes a false positive when candidates are scored.
main_strengths: Both identified findings use valid, directly relevant interview evidence and localize to the correct segments.
The stated mechanisms fully capture the hidden alternative-set narrowing and loss-versus-gain evidence-weighting distortions.
The RAG correctly treats the rollout concern as a candidate rather than an identified bias and avoids findings on the two neutral control decisions.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong mechanism recovery but a taxonomy mismatch: strict label-plus-mechanism performance is zero while mechanism-first performance reaches perfect identification once the low-confidence finding is included. Candidate scoring adds no coverage and reduces precision on this interview.
